name: Azure RBAC (Azure resource roles at a scope, ELIGIBLE through PIM)
status: structure built v2.4.183; eligible-through-PIM since v2.4.373 (was a permanent roleAssignments PUT). Live-validation pending an ARM token + a scope the SPN can manage PIM role eligibility on.
permissionsNeeded: Microsoft.Authorization/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/write + Microsoft.Authorization/roleEligibilitySchedules/read at the target scope (e.g. the 'User Access Administrator' or 'Owner' role for the SPN), Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/read

prerequisites.scopeIsArmPath: Each row's Scope column = the ARM scope path the role applies at, e.g. /subscriptions/<sub> or /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg> or a resource id. Role definitions + eligibilities are listed/created at that scope.
prerequisites.roleIdIsFullPath: listRoles returns each role's full resource id (/subscriptions/.../roleDefinitions/<guid>); the eligibility request body uses it verbatim as roleDefinitionId.
prerequisites.clientGuidPut: ARM creates a role eligibility schedule request with PUT to roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/<new-guid> -- the engine supplies a fresh {newId} per row.
prerequisites.eligibleThroughPim: This connector NEVER creates a permanent (standing) Azure role assignment. It used to PUT Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments -- a standing assignment made OUTSIDE PIM, the same class as SEC-45 for Entra directory roles. The group is now made ELIGIBLE through a PIM role eligibility schedule request (requestType AdminAssign, expiration NoExpiration; no startDateTime, which ARM documents as optional and starts now -- a date token would not survive the JSON round-trip the same way on both PowerShell hosts); its members still ACTIVATE the role under the resource's PIM role settings (MFA, justification, approval, maximum duration). The role settings decide whether a no-expiry eligibility is allowed; if they do not, ARM refuses the request and the engine reports the failure item.
prerequisites.atScopeOnly: listAssignments reads the eligibility schedules AT the row's scope only ($filter=atScope()), so an eligibility inherited from a parent scope is not mistaken for this binding.
prerequisites.removal: A Remove row is REPORTED, not applied: an eligibility carries no 'created by PIM4EntraPS' marker, so the workload runtime never deletes it (the v1 rule for flat assignments). Remove it in Azure -> Privileged Identity Management -> Azure resources, or manage Azure delegation through PIM-Assignments-Azure-Resources, which the engine applies and prunes itself.
prerequisites.tokenAdapter: auth=arm -> token for https://management.azure.com/ via $global:PIM_WorkloadTokens['arm'] (launcher-minted) or Get-AzAccessToken.
